description: This file defines the WelcomeController class within the OrangeHRM installer module, responsible for rendering the welcome screen for the installation process and setting up associated Vue components and state.

classes.name: WelcomeController
classes.description: Controller responsible for preparing and rendering the welcome screen during installation, extending AbstractInstallerVueController.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Setups Vue component for the welcome screen and updates the installation state before rendering.
